import "../../global.css";
import { QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Stack } from "expo-router";
import { StatusBar } from "expo-status-bar";
import { SafeAreaProvider } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import { authClient } from "#src/lib/auth-client.ts";
import { queryClient } from "#src/lib/query-client.ts";

const RootLayout = () => {
  // The guards decide which screens exist, so they wait for the stored session.
  const { data: session, isPending } = authClient.useSession();

  if (isPending) {
    return null;
  }

  const signedIn = session !== null;

  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <Stack>
          <Stack.Screen name="index" options={{ title: "my-app" }} />
          <Stack.Protected guard={!signedIn}>
            <Stack.Screen name="login" options={{ title: "Sign in" }} />
          </Stack.Protected>
        </Stack>
        <StatusBar style="auto" />
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
};

export default RootLayout;

import "../../global.css";
import { QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Stack } from "expo-router";
import { StatusBar } from "expo-status-bar";
import { SafeAreaProvider } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import { authClient } from "#src/lib/auth-client.ts";
import { queryClient } from "#src/lib/query-client.ts";

const RootLayout = () => {
  // The guards decide which screens exist, so they wait for the stored session.
  const { data: session, isPending } = authClient.useSession();

  if (isPending) {
    return null;
  }

  const signedIn = session !== null;

  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <Stack>
          <Stack.Screen name="index" options={{ title: "my-app" }} />
          <Stack.Protected guard={signedIn}>
            <Stack.Screen name="todos" options={{ title: "Todos" }} />
          </Stack.Protected>
          <Stack.Protected guard={!signedIn}>
            <Stack.Screen name="login" options={{ title: "Sign in" }} />
          </Stack.Protected>
        </Stack>
        <StatusBar style="auto" />
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
};

export default RootLayout;

import { Link } from "expo-router";
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-react-native";
import { Pressable, ScrollView, View } from "react-native";

import { ApiStatus } from "#src/components/api-status.tsx";
import { Card } from "#src/components/ui/card.tsx";
import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";
import { UserMenu } from "#src/components/user-menu.tsx";
import { authClient } from "#src/lib/auth-client.ts";

const Home = () => {
  const { data: session } = authClient.useSession();

  return (
    <ScrollView
      className="bg-background"
      contentContainerClassName="gap-6 px-5 py-8"
    >
      <View className="gap-3">
        <Text className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">my-app</Text>
        <Text className="text-muted-foreground leading-6">
          React, Hono, oRPC, SQLite, Drizzle, Better Auth and Expo on Vite+.
        </Text>
        <ApiStatus />
      </View>
      <Card>
        <UserMenu />
        <Link asChild href={session === null ? "/login" : "/todos"}>
          <Pressable className="flex-row items-center justify-between active:opacity-60">
            <Text className="text-primary font-semibold">
              {session === null ? "Sign in to keep todos" : "Open your todos"}
            </Text>
            <ChevronRight className="text-primary" size={18} />
          </Pressable>
        </Link>
      </Card>
    </ScrollView>
  );
};

export default Home;

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Circle, CircleCheck, Trash2 } from "lucide-react-native";
import { useState } from "react";
import { FlatList, Pressable, View } from "react-native";

import { Button } from "#src/components/ui/button.tsx";
import { Input } from "#src/components/ui/input.tsx";
import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";
import { api } from "#src/lib/api.ts";

const Separator = () => <View className="bg-border ml-12 h-px" />;

const Todos = () => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const todos = useQuery(api.todos.list.queryOptions());

  const invalidateTodos = {
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: api.todos.key() });
    },
  };

  const createTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.create.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const updateTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.update.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const deleteTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.delete.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const done = (todos.data ?? []).filter((todo) => todo.completed).length;

  return (
    <View className="bg-background flex-1 gap-4 px-5 pt-5">
      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
        <Input
          accessibilityLabel="New todo"
          className="flex-1"
          onChangeText={setTitle}
          placeholder="What needs to be done?"
          value={title}
        />
        <Button
          disabled={createTodo.isPending || title.trim() === ""}
          label="Add"
          onPress={() => {
            createTodo.mutate(
              { title },
              {
                onSuccess: () => {
                  setTitle("");
                },
              }
            );
          }}
        />
      </View>
      {todos.data !== undefined && todos.data.length > 0 && (
        <Text className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
          {done} of {todos.data.length} done
        </Text>
      )}
      <FlatList
        contentContainerClassName="border-border bg-card mb-8 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border"
        data={todos.data ?? []}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={Separator}
        keyExtractor={(todo) => todo.id}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View className="items-center gap-1 px-4 py-10">
            <Text className="font-medium">
              {todos.isPending ? "Loading…" : "No todos yet."}
            </Text>
            {!todos.isPending && (
              <Text className="text-muted-foreground text-center text-sm">
                Each one you add is saved through the API.
              </Text>
            )}
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 pr-2">
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="checkbox"
              accessibilityState={{ checked: item.completed }}
              className="flex-1 flex-row items-center gap-3 py-3.5 pl-4 active:opacity-60"
              onPress={() => {
                updateTodo.mutate({ completed: !item.completed, id: item.id });
              }}
            >
              {item.completed ? (
                <CircleCheck className="text-primary" size={22} />
              ) : (
                <Circle className="text-muted-foreground" size={22} />
              )}
              <Text
                className={
                  item.completed
                    ? "text-muted-foreground flex-1 line-through"
                    : "flex-1"
                }
              >
                {item.title}
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              accessibilityLabel={`Delete ${item.title}`}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full active:opacity-60"
              hitSlop={4}
              onPress={() => {
                deleteTodo.mutate({ id: item.id });
              }}
            >
              <Trash2 className="text-muted-foreground" size={18} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}
      />
    </View>
  );
};

export default Todos;

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Circle, CircleCheck, Trash2 } from "lucide-react-native";
import { useState } from "react";
import { FlatList, Pressable, View } from "react-native";

import { Button } from "#src/components/ui/button.tsx";
import { Input } from "#src/components/ui/input.tsx";
import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";
import { api } from "#src/lib/api.ts";

const Separator = () => <View className="bg-border ml-12 h-px" />;

const Todos = () => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const todos = useQuery(api.todos.list.queryOptions());

  const invalidateTodos = {
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: api.todos.key() });
    },
  };

  const createTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.create.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const updateTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.update.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const deleteTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.delete.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const done = (todos.data ?? []).filter((todo) => todo.completed).length;

  return (
    <View className="bg-background flex-1 gap-4 px-5 pt-5">
      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
        <Input
          accessibilityLabel="New todo"
          className="flex-1"
          onChangeText={setTitle}
          placeholder="What needs to be done?"
          value={title}
        />
        <Button
          disabled={createTodo.isPending || title.trim() === ""}
          label="Add"
          onPress={() => {
            createTodo.mutate(
              { title },
              {
                onSuccess: () => {
                  setTitle("");
                },
              }
            );
          }}
        />
      </View>
      {todos.data !== undefined && todos.data.length > 0 && (
        <Text className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
          {done} of {todos.data.length} done
        </Text>
      )}
      <FlatList
        contentContainerClassName="border-border bg-card mb-8 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border"
        data={todos.data ?? []}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={Separator}
        keyExtractor={(todo) => String(todo.id)}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View className="items-center gap-1 px-4 py-10">
            <Text className="font-medium">
              {todos.isPending ? "Loading…" : "No todos yet."}
            </Text>
            {!todos.isPending && (
              <Text className="text-muted-foreground text-center text-sm">
                Each one you add is saved through the API.
              </Text>
            )}
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 pr-2">
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="checkbox"
              accessibilityState={{ checked: item.completed }}
              className="flex-1 flex-row items-center gap-3 py-3.5 pl-4 active:opacity-60"
              onPress={() => {
                updateTodo.mutate({ completed: !item.completed, id: item.id });
              }}
            >
              {item.completed ? (
                <CircleCheck className="text-primary" size={22} />
              ) : (
                <Circle className="text-muted-foreground" size={22} />
              )}
              <Text
                className={
                  item.completed
                    ? "text-muted-foreground flex-1 line-through"
                    : "flex-1"
                }
              >
                {item.title}
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              accessibilityLabel={`Delete ${item.title}`}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full active:opacity-60"
              hitSlop={4}
              onPress={() => {
                deleteTodo.mutate({ id: item.id });
              }}
            >
              <Trash2 className="text-muted-foreground" size={18} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}
      />
    </View>
  );
};

export default Todos;

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { View } from "react-native";

import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";
import { apiUrl } from "#src/env.ts";

const checkHealth = async () => {
  const response = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/health`);

  return response.ok;
};

export const ApiStatus = () => {
  const health = useQuery({ queryFn: checkHealth, queryKey: ["health"] });

  if (health.isPending) {
    return (
      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
        <View className="bg-muted-foreground size-2 rounded-full" />
        <Text className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">Checking the API…</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return health.data === true ? (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
      <View className="bg-success size-2 rounded-full" />
      <Text className="text-sm">API connected</Text>
    </View>
  ) : (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
      <View className="bg-destructive size-2 rounded-full" />
      <Text className="text-destructive flex-1 text-sm">
        API unreachable at {apiUrl}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
};

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { View } from "react-native";

import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";
import { apiUrl } from "#src/env.ts";
import { api } from "#src/lib/api.ts";

export const ApiStatus = () => {
  const health = useQuery(api.health.queryOptions());

  if (health.isPending) {
    return (
      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
        <View className="bg-muted-foreground size-2 rounded-full" />
        <Text className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">Checking the API…</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return health.isSuccess ? (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
      <View className="bg-success size-2 rounded-full" />
      <Text className="text-sm">API connected</Text>
    </View>
  ) : (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
      <View className="bg-destructive size-2 rounded-full" />
      <Text className="text-destructive flex-1 text-sm">
        API unreachable at {apiUrl}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState } from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";

import { Button } from "#src/components/ui/button.tsx";
import { Input } from "#src/components/ui/input.tsx";
import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";
import { authClient } from "#src/lib/auth-client.ts";

export const AuthForm = () => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"sign-in" | "sign-up">("sign-in");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const { error, isPending, mutate, reset } = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const result =
        mode === "sign-in"
          ? await authClient.signIn.email({ email, password })
          : await authClient.signUp.email({ email, name, password });

      if (result.error) {
        throw new Error(result.error.message ?? result.error.statusText);
      }
    },
  });

  return (
    <View className="gap-3">
      <View className="mb-3 gap-1">
        <Text className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          {mode === "sign-in" ? "Welcome back" : "Create your account"}
        </Text>
        <Text className="text-muted-foreground">
          {mode === "sign-in"
            ? "Sign in with your email and password."
            : "Sign up with your email and a password."}
        </Text>
      </View>
      {mode === "sign-up" && (
        <Input
          autoComplete="name"
          onChangeText={setName}
          placeholder="Name"
          value={name}
        />
      )}
      <Input
        autoCapitalize="none"
        autoComplete="email"
        keyboardType="email-address"
        onChangeText={setEmail}
        placeholder="Email"
        value={email}
      />
      <Input
        autoComplete={mode === "sign-in" ? "current-password" : "new-password"}
        onChangeText={setPassword}
        placeholder="Password"
        secureTextEntry
        value={password}
      />
      {error !== null && (
        <Text className="text-destructive">{error.message}</Text>
      )}
      <Button
        disabled={isPending}
        label={mode === "sign-in" ? "Sign in" : "Create account"}
        onPress={() => {
          mutate();
        }}
      />
      <Button
        disabled={isPending}
        label={
          mode === "sign-in" ? "Create an account instead" : "Sign in instead"
        }
        onPress={() => {
          reset();
          setMode(mode === "sign-in" ? "sign-up" : "sign-in");
        }}
        variant="outline"
      />
    </View>
  );
};

import { cva } from "class-variance-authority";
import type { VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { cn } from "cn";
import { Pressable } from "react-native";
import type { PressableProps } from "react-native";

import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "h-12 flex-row items-center justify-center rounded-xl px-5 active:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-40",
  {
    defaultVariants: { variant: "default" },
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary",
        outline: "border-border bg-card border",
      },
    },
  }
);

const labelVariants = cva("text-base font-semibold", {
  defaultVariants: { variant: "default" },
  variants: {
    variant: {
      default: "text-primary-foreground",
      outline: "text-foreground",
    },
  },
});

type ButtonProps = PressableProps &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & { readonly label: string };

export const Button = ({
  className,
  label,
  variant,
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) => (
  <Pressable
    accessibilityRole="button"
    className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant }), className)}
    {...props}
  >
    <Text className={labelVariants({ variant })}>{label}</Text>
  </Pressable>
);

import { LogOut } from "lucide-react-native";
import { Pressable, View } from "react-native";

import { Text } from "#src/components/ui/text.tsx";
import { authClient } from "#src/lib/auth-client.ts";

export const UserMenu = () => {
  const { data: session } = authClient.useSession();

  if (!session) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
      <Text className="text-muted-foreground">{session.user.email}</Text>
      <Pressable
        accessibilityLabel="Sign out"
        accessibilityRole="button"
        hitSlop={8}
        onPress={async () => {
          await authClient.signOut();
        }}
      >
        <LogOut className="text-foreground" size={20} />
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
};

import Constants from "expo-constants";
import { z } from "zod";

import { resolveApiUrl } from "#src/lib/api-url.ts";

// Expo inlines EXPO_PUBLIC_* only where the code names the variable in full.
const configured = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL;

export const apiUrl = resolveApiUrl({
  configured: z
    .url()
    .optional()
    .parse(configured === "" ? undefined : configured),
  dev: __DEV__,
  hostUri: Constants.expoConfig?.hostUri,
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vite-plus/test";

import { resolveApiUrl } from "#src/lib/api-url.ts";

describe(resolveApiUrl, () => {
  it("prefers the configured origin", () => {
    expect(
      resolveApiUrl({
        configured: "https://api.example.com",
        dev: true,
        hostUri: "192.168.1.20:8081",
      })
    ).toBe("https://api.example.com");
  });

  it.each([
    ["192.168.1.20:8081", "http://192.168.1.20:3000"],
    ["10.0.2.2:8081", "http://10.0.2.2:3000"],
    ["localhost:8081", "http://localhost:3000"],
  ])("reaches the server beside Metro at %s in development", (hostUri, url) => {
    expect(resolveApiUrl({ configured: undefined, dev: true, hostUri })).toBe(
      url
    );
  });

  it("refuses a release build without an origin", () => {
    expect(() =>
      resolveApiUrl({
        configured: undefined,
        dev: false,
        hostUri: "192.168.1.20:8081",
      })
    ).toThrow("EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL");
  });
});

#   tanstack-start-self-sqlite-expo-docker
#   tanstack-start-self-sqlite-expo-docker-e2e
// Every app shape answers the API on :3000: Hono, or the framework that forwards to it.
const apiPort = 3000;

interface ApiUrlSource {
  readonly configured: string | undefined;
  readonly hostUri: string | undefined;
  readonly dev: boolean;
}

/** Development reaches the server on the machine Metro runs on; a release build needs EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL. */
export const resolveApiUrl = ({ configured, hostUri, dev }: ApiUrlSource) => {
  if (configured !== undefined) {
    return configured;
  }

  const host = hostUri?.split(":")[0];

  if (dev && host !== undefined && host !== "") {
    return `http://${host}:${apiPort}`;
  }

  throw new Error("Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to the API origin for this build.");
};

import { mutationOptions, queryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { UseMutationOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { parseResponse } from "hono/client";

import { createClient } from "#src/lib/client.ts";

type Client = ReturnType<typeof createClient>;

const mutation = <Input, Output>(
  mutationFn: (input: Input) => Promise<Output>
) => ({
  mutationOptions: (
    options: Pick<UseMutationOptions<Output, Error, Input>, "onSuccess"> = {}
  ) => mutationOptions({ ...options, mutationFn }),
});

const todosKey = ["todos"] as const;

const createQueries = (client: Client) => ({
  todos: {
    create: mutation(
      async (json: { title: string }) =>
        await parseResponse(client.todos.$post({ json }))
    ),
    delete: mutation(
      async ({ id }: { id: string }) =>
        await parseResponse(client.todos[":id"].$delete({ param: { id } }))
    ),
    key: () => todosKey,
    list: {
      queryOptions: () =>
        queryOptions({
          queryFn: async () => await parseResponse(client.todos.$get()),
          queryKey: [...todosKey, "list"],
        }),
    },
    update: mutation(
      async ({ completed, id }: { completed: boolean; id: string }) =>
        await parseResponse(
          client.todos[":id"].$patch({
            json: { completed },
            param: { id },
          })
        )
    ),
  },
});

export const api = createQueries(createClient());

import { mutationOptions, queryOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { UseMutationOptions } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { parseResponse } from "hono/client";

import { createClient } from "#src/lib/client.ts";

type Client = ReturnType<typeof createClient>;

const mutation = <Input, Output>(
  mutationFn: (input: Input) => Promise<Output>
) => ({
  mutationOptions: (
    options: Pick<UseMutationOptions<Output, Error, Input>, "onSuccess"> = {}
  ) => mutationOptions({ ...options, mutationFn }),
});

const todosKey = ["todos"] as const;

const createQueries = (client: Client) => ({
  todos: {
    create: mutation(
      async (json: { title: string }) =>
        await parseResponse(client.todos.$post({ json }))
    ),
    delete: mutation(
      async ({ id }: { id: number }) =>
        await parseResponse(
          client.todos[":id"].$delete({ param: { id: String(id) } })
        )
    ),
    key: () => todosKey,
    list: {
      queryOptions: () =>
        queryOptions({
          queryFn: async () => await parseResponse(client.todos.$get()),
          queryKey: [...todosKey, "list"],
        }),
    },
    update: mutation(
      async ({ completed, id }: { completed: boolean; id: number }) =>
        await parseResponse(
          client.todos[":id"].$patch({
            json: { completed },
            param: { id: String(id) },
          })
        )
    ),
  },
});

export const api = createQueries(createClient());

import { createORPCClient } from "@orpc/client";
import { RPCLink } from "@orpc/client/fetch";
import { createTanstackQueryUtils } from "@orpc/tanstack-query";

import type { AppRouterClient } from "@my-app/api";

import { apiUrl } from "#src/env.ts";
import { authClient } from "#src/lib/auth-client.ts";

const link = new RPCLink({
  // Native fetch has no cookie jar: Better Auth's Expo client keeps the session, and each request sends it.
  fetch: async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) =>
    await fetch(input, { ...init, credentials: "omit" }),
  headers: async () => ({ cookie: await authClient.getCookie() }),
  url: `${apiUrl}/rpc`,
});

const client: AppRouterClient = createORPCClient(link);

export const api = createTanstackQueryUtils(client);

import { expoClient } from "@better-auth/expo/client";
import { createAuthClient } from "better-auth/react";
import * as SecureStore from "expo-secure-store";

import { apiUrl } from "#src/env.ts";

// The scheme in `app.json`, which the server trusts as this app's origin.
const scheme = "my-app";

export const authClient = createAuthClient({
  baseURL: apiUrl,
  plugins: [
    expoClient({ scheme, storage: SecureStore, storagePrefix: scheme }),
  ],
});

import { hc } from "hono/client";

import type { Api } from "@my-app/api";

import { apiUrl } from "#src/env.ts";
import { authClient } from "#src/lib/auth-client.ts";

export const createClient = () =>
  hc<Api>(`${apiUrl}/api`, {
    // Native fetch has no cookie jar: Better Auth's Expo client keeps the session, and each request sends it.
    fetch: async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) =>
      await fetch(input, { ...init, credentials: "omit" }),
    headers: async () => ({ cookie: await authClient.getCookie() }),
  });
